svg.title: A pool buys real cores and charges a toll on every task
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “A pool buys real cores and charges a toll on every task” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A parent process fanning work through a dashed pickle toll booth out to four child processes, each drawn with its own GIL. Bars compare worker startup at 54 ms for spawn, 43.2 ms for forkserver and 3.8 ms for fork. A crossover curve shows the pool below break-even until about 100 000 iterations of work per task, with the losing region hachured in red, and a sketch shows eight workers each spawning eleven BLAS threads onto eleven cores.
svg.text: A pool buys real cores and charges a toll on every task
draw it from memory, then compare
